BOMBER MOLE - RetroStone VC (Windows build)
All rights reserved, 8BCraft (Pierre-Louis Boyer). Preview build: AI-generated art under review (placeholders where none yet), placeholder sound.

Run BomberMole.exe. No installation needed (SDL2 is built in).

Keyboard                         Gamepad (SNES layout, up to 4 pads)
  Arrows ....... move/dig          D-pad / left stick
  Z ............ drop a bomb (B)   bottom button (B)
  X ............ detonate (A)      right button (A)
  A / S ........ Y / X             left / top buttons
  Q / W ........ L / R             shoulders
  Enter ........ Start (pause)     Start
  Backspace .... Select            Back / Select
  F11 or Alt+Enter: fullscreen    F12: screenshot    Esc: quit

Options: BomberMole.exe --scale 4 --fullscreen
Progress is saved in bombermole.srm next to the exe.
Levels can be edited without rebuilding: put files in data\levels\ next to the
exe (same names as in the game sources, e.g. data\levels\spring-1.txt).
Tester cheat: on the level select screen, hold L+R and press Select to unlock everything.
